questions.subject: champion
questions.label: Priscilla, the Spider Queen
questions.question: Which of these champions began as the scrapped champion Priscilla?
questions.answer: Priscilla, the Spider Queen was scrapped after she already had an in-game model. After a Petition on the League of Legends forum, Presilla was eventually reworked into Elise. Her original name was Nidalee which was reused and confirmed to have no other relations.

questions.subject: champion
questions.label: Ao Shin
questions.question: Which of these champions began as the scrapped champion Ao Shin?
questions.answer: Ao Shin was scrapped, and the dragon idea was eventually released as Aurelion Sol. His Storm Dragon skin is a direct tribute to the original concept.

questions.subject: champion
questions.label: Seth, the Sand Mage
questions.question: Which of these champions was reworked from the scrapped champion Seth?
questions.answer: Riot could not get the Sand Mage concept right in the time it had, and the game could not yet support the visual effects it needed. The idea was reworked into Azir.

questions.subject: champion
questions.label: Void Ray
questions.question: Which of these champions was reworked from the scrapped champion concept Void Ray?
questions.answer: The airborne champion first appeared on a Battlecast promo blueprint and was later glimpsed in splash art and a recall animation, long before it became Bel'Veth.

questions.subject: champion
questions.label: Komachi
questions.question: Which of these champions recycled the concepts of the scrapped champion Komachi?
questions.answer: Komachi was planned as a pure tank wielding a scythe, designed by Kuo-Yen 'Xypherous' Lo. When it was shelved, its concepts were recycled for Thresh.

questions.subject: champion
questions.label: Omen
questions.question: Which of these champions recycled the concepts of the scrapped champion Omen?
questions.answer: Riot shelved Omen because it could not find a suitable personality for it. The name was later reused for an agent in Valorant.

questions.subject: champion
questions.label: Husk, the Hive Commander
questions.question: Which of these champions grew out of the scrapped champion Husk, the Hive Commander?
questions.answer: Husk was invisioned as a mercenary from Zaun and ex-partner of Caitlyn. The concept was split and used for the two champions: Camille and Kai'Sa.

questions.subject: text
questions.label: Magma Chamber and Arena
questions.question: Which game mode recycled the concept of Magma Chamber, a cancelled 2v2 map?
questions.answer: Magma Chamber was first played publicly as a 2v2 map at the 2013 All-Star Showdown. When the 2v2 idea returned as Arena, Magma Chamber became one of its maps.

questions.subject: text
questions.label: Magma Chamber and Dominion
questions.question: Which game mode was reworked from Magma Chamber, first announced in 2010 as a 5v5 map and then cancelled?
questions.answer: Dominion was a capture-and-hold mode on the Crystal Scar. It launched in September 2011 and was retired in 2016 because too few people played it.

questions.subject: text
questions.label: Dominion map
questions.question: Which map was the Dominion game mode played on?
questions.answer: On the Crystal Scar, two teams fought over five capture points, and holding more of them drained the enemy nexus. The map was removed from the game files in January 2018.

questions.subject: text
questions.label: Map removed in 2019
questions.question: Which map was removed from League of Legends in 2019?
questions.answer: Twisted Treeline was a smaller 3v3 map with two lanes that had been in the game since launch. It was retired at the end of Season 2019 because so few people played it.

questions.subject: champion
questions.label: The original 17
questions.question: Which of these champions was one of the original 17, released in February 2009?

questions.subject: champion
questions.label: A tribute to Joe
questions.question: Which of these champions says "Bravest hero I ever knew was just a kid. Here's to you, champ.", a tribute to Joe, a young fan who visited Riot through Make-A-Wish?
questions.answer: Joe had Ewing's sarcoma and visited Riot's headquarters through Make-A-Wish. He died in June 2012, and his favorite skin, Jaximus, carries a tribute line of its own: "Here's to you, kid."

questions.subject: text
questions.label: Jaximus
questions.question: Which Jax skin's sales did Riot give to Make-A-Wish in 2012, for a young fan named Joe?
questions.answer: Joe had Ewing's sarcoma and visited Riot's headquarters through Make-A-Wish, and Jaximus was his favorite skin. The skin's line "Here's to you, kid." is a tribute to him.

questions.subject: champion
questions.label: "OK."
questions.question: Which of these champions is famous for answering almost every command with "OK."?
questions.answer: Rammus has the fewest quotes of any champion, only six, and is the only one without a joke in English. In several other languages he has a full set of taunts and jokes.

questions.subject: text
questions.label: Baron Nashor and Roshan
questions.question: Which game has the boss Roshan, whose name Baron Nashor's is an anagram of?
questions.answer: League of Legends was originally based on Defense of the Ancients, so its biggest neutral monster got a reshuffled version of a DotA name.

questions.subject: item
questions.label: Named after Guinsoo
questions.question: Which of these items is named after Steve Feak, the creator of Defense of the Ancients: Allstars?
questions.answer: According to Feak, Guinsoo's Rageblade was made with Corki in mind. Its icon resembles Guinsoo's Scythe of Vyse, a Defense of the Ancients item also named after him.

questions.subject: champion
questions.label: K/DA
questions.question: Which of these champions is a member of the band K/DA?
questions.answer: K/DA debuted with POP/STARS at the 2018 World Championship opening ceremony. Seraphine joined the group for the 2020 EP ALL OUT.

questions.subject: champion
questions.label: Pentakill
questions.question: Which of these champions is a member of the metal band Pentakill?
questions.answer: In Pentakill's story, a mountain fell on Mordekaiser once he had brought metal to the masses, and legend said whoever drew the axe from its peak would herald a new age of metal.

questions.subject: champion
questions.label: True Damage
questions.question: Which of these champions is a member of the band True Damage?
questions.answer: True Damage calls itself a collective of the best artists from around the world, making hip-hop. Its GIANTS music video also gave the first glimpse of Riot Forge.

questions.subject: champion
questions.label: HEARTSTEEL
questions.question: Which of these champions is a member of the band HEARTSTEEL?
questions.answer: HEARTSTEEL debuted in 2023 with the song PARANOIA.

questions.subject: champion
questions.label: Ultimate skins
questions.question: Which of these champions has an Ultimate skin?
questions.answer: There are seven Ultimate skins: Pulsefire Ezreal (2012), Spirit Guard Udyr (2013), DJ Sona (2015), Elementalist Lux (2016), Gun Goddess Miss Fortune (2018), ALL OUT Seraphine (2020) and Soul Fighter Samira (2023).

questions.subject: text
questions.label: The Mageseeker
questions.question: Which Riot Forge game stars Sylas?
questions.answer: The Mageseeker was made by Digital Sun Games for Riot Forge, a label that worked with studios outside Riot to make League of Legends games.

questions.subject: text
questions.label: CONV/RGENCE
questions.question: Which Riot Forge game stars Ekko?
questions.answer: CONV/RGENCE was made by Double Stallion Games for Riot Forge. Riot stopped making Forge games in 2024, during mass layoffs.

questions.subject: text
questions.label: Hextech Mayhem
questions.question: Which Riot Forge game stars Ziggs?
questions.answer: Hextech Mayhem was made by Choice Provisions, one of the outside studios Riot Forge partnered with.

questions.subject: champion
questions.label: Ruined King
questions.question: Which of these champions is playable in the Riot Forge game Ruined King?
questions.answer: Ruined King was made by Airship Syndicate for Riot Forge. It is a turn-based role-playing game set in Bilgewater and the Shadow Isles.

questions.subject: text
questions.label: Arcane studio
questions.question: Which studio produced the animated series Arcane?
questions.answer: Fortiche is a French animation studio based in Paris that had made champion videos for Riot before Arcane.

questions.subject: text
questions.label: Arcane premiere
questions.question: Which streaming service did Arcane premiere on worldwide in 2021?
questions.answer: Netflix picked up Arcane for international release in May 2021. Its second season followed in November 2024, released in three acts.

questions.subject: text
questions.label: Added in 2024
questions.question: Which neutral monster was added to Summoner's Rift in 2024?
questions.answer: Voidgrubs spawn in the Baron pit, three of them, once per game. Each one killed makes enemy structures burn, and the third summons allied Voidmites to help take down turrets.

questions.subject: text
questions.label: Added in 2025
questions.question: Which neutral monster was added to Summoner's Rift in 2025?
questions.answer: Atakhan spawned on whichever side of the river had seen more fighting by 14 minutes. In the lore he is the demon Mordekaiser bound to his service as his Bringer of Ruin.

questions.subject: text
questions.label: Tier added in 2023
questions.question: Which ranked tier was added in 2023?
questions.answer: Emerald arrived in Split 2 of Season 2023, between Platinum and Diamond. The promotion series between tiers was removed at the same time.

questions.subject: text
questions.label: Tiers added in 2019
questions.question: Which ranked tier was added in 2019?
questions.answer: Season 2019 added Iron at the bottom of the ladder and Grandmaster below Challenger, and cut the divisions in each tier from five to four.

questions.subject: text
questions.label: Tier added in 2014
questions.question: Which ranked tier was added in 2014?
questions.answer: Master was added in Season 2014 with a single division, between Diamond and Challenger.

questions.subject: text
questions.label: Urf
questions.question: Which animal is Urf, Riot's April Fools' mascot?
questions.answer: Urf began as a 'cancelled' champion in an April Fools' Day joke and has been Riot's mascot ever since, showing up around April 1st. In his story, he idolized Jax above all other champions.

questions.subject: text
questions.label: Ultra Rapid Fire
questions.question: Which occasion was the Ultra Rapid Fire mode first introduced for?
questions.answer: In Ultra Rapid Fire, abilities cost nothing and every champion gets 300 ability haste. Recent runs have used All Random picks.

questions.subject: text
questions.label: Riot founders
questions.question: Which person founded Riot Games together with Marc Merrill in 2006?
questions.answer: Beck and Merrill were roommates at the University of Southern California. They wanted a company that keeps improving one game after its release instead of moving on to a new one.

questions.subject: text
questions.label: Riot owner
questions.question: Which company has fully owned Riot Games since 2015?
questions.answer: Tencent bought a majority of Riot Games in February 2011 and the rest in December 2015.

questions.subject: text
questions.label: Release year
questions.question: Which year was League of Legends released in?
questions.answer: League of Legends launched on 27 October 2009, and the 3v3 Twisted Treeline map launched alongside it.

questions.subject: text
questions.label: Defense of the Ancients
questions.question: Which game was Defense of the Ancients, the map League of Legends is based on, made for?
questions.answer: Steve 'Guinsoo' Feak, who created Defense of the Ancients: Allstars, was one of the main creative minds behind League of Legends.

questions.subject: champion
questions.label: Brandon Beck's alias
questions.question: Which of these champions is named after the in-game name of Riot co-founder Brandon Beck?
questions.answer: Ryze was also the first champion to have nine skins.

questions.subject: champion
questions.label: Marc Merrill's alias
questions.question: Which of these champions shares its name with the in-game name of Riot co-founder Marc Merrill?

questions.subject: champion
questions.label: Colt 'Ezreal' Hallam
questions.question: Which of these champions is named after the Rioter Colt Hallam's in-game name?
questions.answer: Ezreal was also the first champion to get a Champion Spotlight video.

questions.subject: champion
questions.label: Crab species
questions.question: Which of these champions had a species of crab, discovered in 2024, named after them?
questions.answer: The Gothus teemo crab was discovered in the South China Sea and was named after the board game Go as well as Teemo.

questions.subject: champion
questions.label: 100th champion
questions.question: Which of these champions was the 100th champion released?
questions.answer: Jayce was also the first champion with eight abilities, since his ultimate switches between a hammer and a cannon stance with their own spells.

questions.subject: text
questions.label: Started as a mode
questions.question: Which Riot game started in 2019 as a game mode inside League of Legends?
questions.answer: Within weeks it took up 20 to 40% of the hours played in League, depending on the region, and Riot made it permanent.

questions.subject: text
questions.label: Project A
questions.question: Which Riot game was announced under the codename Project A?
questions.answer: Project A was short for Project Ares. The 5v5 tactical shooter came out on June 2, 2020.

questions.subject: text
questions.label: Song of Nunu
questions.question: Which Riot Forge game stars Nunu & Willump?
questions.answer: Song of Nunu is a single-player adventure made by Tequila Works for Riot Forge, in which Nunu searches for his lost mother.

questions.subject: champion
questions.label: Hailee Steinfeld
questions.question: Which of these champions does Hailee Steinfeld voice in Arcane?

questions.subject: champion
questions.label: Ella Purnell
questions.question: Which of these champions does Ella Purnell voice in Arcane?
questions.answer: Ella Purnell voices both the grown-up Jinx and Powder, the girl she used to be. Young Powder is voiced by Mia Sinclair Jenness.

questions.subject: text
questions.label: Six against six
questions.question: Which game mode pitted two teams of six players against each other?
questions.answer: Its name comes from the six-kill announcement that only six players per team make possible. It first ran on live servers in February 2014.

questions.subject: text
questions.label: Picking for the enemy
questions.question: Which game mode had each player pick a champion for the enemy team?
questions.answer: Nemesis Draft ran only once, in February 2015, and was removed ten days later: players did not enjoy losing the choice of their own champion.

questions.subject: champion
questions.label: Ascension boss
questions.question: Which of these champions stood at the centre of the map as the boss of the Ascension game mode?
questions.answer: Killing him gave the 'Ascension' buff, which greatly empowered whoever held it. If all ten players danced around him, he danced too.

questions.subject: champion
questions.label: Doom Bots boss
questions.question: Which of these champions leads the Doom Bots of Doom?
questions.answer: Players have to hold out against his overpowered bots for 15 minutes before he comes down to fight them himself.

questions.subject: champion
questions.label: Odyssey boss
questions.question: Which of these champions was the final boss of the game mode Odyssey: Extraction?
questions.answer: The 2018 mode was a PvE fight against a series of monsters, and only the other Odyssey champions could be played.

questions.subject: text
questions.label: Home of the Poros
questions.question: Which map were Poros first introduced on, in 2012?
questions.answer: Feeding a Poro a Poro-Snax as Braum gives it a mustache in the color of his skin.

questions.subject: text
questions.label: Same champion
questions.question: Which game mode has every player on a team play the same champion?
questions.answer: Each player votes for a champion, and the whole team then plays the one that was picked.

questions.subject: text
questions.label: Disabled drake
questions.question: Which elemental drake was switched off by a hotfix in early 2022 after negative feedback?
questions.answer: It was disabled in patch 12.2 and came back in 12.22 with new effects and without its fog.

questions.subject: text
questions.label: Removed item class
questions.question: Which class of items was removed from League of Legends in patch 14.1, in 2024?
questions.answer: A player could carry only one Mythic item, and its passive grew stronger with every Legendary item they owned.

questions.subject: champion
questions.label: Edmundo Sanchez
questions.question: Which of these champions is named after Edmundo 'odnumde' Sanchez?
questions.answer: Before his rework, Dr. Mundo's dance referenced the title character of House, M.D., dancing to Fight the Power by Public Enemy.

questions.subject: champion
questions.label: Jin Ho Yang
questions.question: Which of these champions is named after his visual effects artist?
questions.answer: During development his name and title were 'Jin, the Artisan Killer' and he was named Jin Ho Yang.

questions.subject: champion
questions.label: Jeff 'Kassadin' Jew
questions.question: Which of these champions is named after Jeff Jew, later the lead producer of Legends of Runeterra?
questions.answer: The name was Jeff Jew's own nickname, the way Ezreal, Ryze and Tryndamere are named after Rioters' nicknames.

questions.subject: champion
questions.label: Veigar Bouius
questions.question: Which of these champions is named after a former Riot senior QA analyst who is 'quite tall'?
questions.answer: The analyst was Veigar Bouius. In Legends of Runeterra the champion's name is pronounced 'vy-gar'.

questions.subject: champion
questions.label: Armored bears meme
questions.question: Which of these champions is named after a forum user's long-running meme about a certain armored animal?
questions.answer: The forum user was Travis 'Volibar' George, who kept championing armored bears in the League.

questions.subject: champion
questions.label: Guinsoo's dog
questions.question: Which of these champions is named after Steve 'Guinsoo' Feak's dog?
questions.answer: Nunu is also a nickname for his wife.

questions.subject: champion
questions.label: Maokai Xiao
questions.question: Which of these champions is named after its concept artist, Maokai Xiao?
questions.answer: Maokai was named after his concept artist Maokai Xiao?.

questions.subject: champion
questions.label: Every letter used
questions.question: Which of these champions was released in 2013 as the first whose name starts with the last unused letter of the alphabet?
questions.answer: Q was the only letter left that no champion's name started with. Qiyana became the second in 2019.

questions.subject: champion
questions.label: Fewer than five abilities
questions.question: Which of these champions is the only one with fewer than five abilities?
questions.answer: His kit is so unusual that he has his own version of the in-game HUD.

questions.subject: champion
questions.label: Exclamation marks
questions.question: Which of these champions has an exclamation mark at the end of every ability name?
questions.answer: When Jinx is on the enemy team, Vi and Caitlyn get a cosmetic debuff of their own: 'Catch me if you can!'.

questions.subject: champion
questions.label: Shields turrets
questions.question: Which of these champions is the only one who can shield turrets?
questions.answer: Shielding a turret can even help her pick up kills.

questions.subject: champion
questions.label: First to use energy
questions.question: Which of these champions was the first to use energy instead of mana?

questions.subject: champion
questions.label: First to transform
questions.question: Which of these champions was the first with an ability that transforms them?

questions.subject: champion
questions.label: Melee to ranged
questions.question: Which of these champions was the first to be changed from melee to ranged, in patch 9.20?
questions.answer: If he dances after summoning Daisy, she dances along.

questions.subject: champion
questions.label: Ability named like the title
questions.question: Which of these champions has an ability with the same name as their title?

answerFor.Volibear: His passive, The Relentless Storm, shares its name with his title, the Relentless Storm.
answerFor.Aatrox: His Q, The Darkin Blade, shares its name with his title, the Darkin Blade.
answerFor.Elise: Her passive, Spider Queen, shares its name with her title, the Spider Queen.
answerFor.Jax: His ultimate, Grandmaster-at-Arms, shares its name with his title, Grandmaster at Arms.
answerFor.Sejuani: Her passive, Fury of the North, shares its name with her title, Fury of the North.
answerFor.Vayne: Her passive, Night Hunter, shares its name with her title, the Night Hunter.

questions.subject: champion
questions.label: First after launch
questions.question: Which of these champions was the first released after the game's official launch on 27 October 2009?
questions.answer: He came out on 2 December 2009, a little over a month after launch.

questions.subject: champion
questions.label: Reverted rework
questions.question: Which of these champions is the only one whose gameplay rework was completely reverted?
questions.answer: Her 2017 version was very hard to balance, so Riot put her old kit back. Only the new ability icons were kept.

questions.subject: champion
questions.label: Fewest quotes
questions.question: Which of these champions has the fewest voice lines in English, and no joke at all?
questions.answer: He has six. Several other languages, such as French, German and Korean, give him a full set of taunts and jokes.

questions.subject: champion
questions.label: First Prestige Edition
questions.question: Which of these champions was the first to get a Prestige Edition skin?
questions.answer: She was also the first champion to get chromas on release.

questions.subject: champion
questions.label: TFT before League
questions.question: Which of these champions came to Teamfight Tactics before League of Legends?
questions.answer: She was already in development for League, but Teamfight Tactics gave her simpler art of its own for its Into the Arcane set first.

questions.subject: champion
questions.label: Unit radius
questions.question: Which of these champions is the only champion to have a non standard Unit radius?
questions.answer: Ivern has a unit radius of 70, instead of one of the standard values of (55/65/80). No one knows why, exactly.

questions.subject: text
questions.label: Most songs
questions.question: Which of these League of Legends bands has released the most songs?
questions.answer: Pentakill's three albums hold 30 tracks: 8 on Smite and Ignite (2014), 11 on Grasp of the Undying (2017) and 11 on Lost Chapter (2021). Most of them are named after items.

questions.subject: text
questions.label: Launcher code
questions.question: Which phrase could players type into the old League of Legends launcher to make a greyed-out Play button clickable again?
questions.answer: It worked when the launcher could not reach the server and showed lines of code instead of the news. Forum posts sharing it were long taken for trolling, until players found it really worked.

questions.subject: champion
questions.label: Ears pointing up
questions.question: Which of these champions is the only yordle whose ears point upwards?
questions.answer: Why hers point up, unlike the rest of her kind, is not known.

questions.subject: champion
questions.label: U Can't Touch This
questions.question: Which of these champions has a dance that references MC Hammer's U Can't Touch This?

answerFor.Malzahar: His Voidlings dance it along with him.

questions.subject: champion
questions.label: South Park dance
questions.question: Which of these champions has a dance that references the goth kids from South Park?
questions.answer: The goth kids' dance in turn parodies the shuffling dance of the Peanuts characters.

questions.subject: champion
questions.label: Do a barrel roll
questions.question: Which of these champions has a dance that references "Do a barrel roll!" from Star Fox 64?
questions.answer: In Star Fox 64 the line is spoken by Peppy Hare.

questions.subject: champion
questions.label: Remember the Time

questions.subject: champion

questions.answer: He kept the dance through his rework.

questions.subject: champion

questions.answer: Several Skarners dancing at once move in sync.

questions.subject: champion
questions.label: Technoviking

questions.subject: champion
questions.label: Dancing Trollface
questions.question: Which of these champions has a dance that references the Dancing Trollface meme?
questions.answer: The more movement speed he has, the faster he dances.

questions.subject: champion
questions.label: Running Man
questions.question: Which of these champions has a dance that references the Running Man?
questions.answer: The more movement speed he has, the faster he dances.

questions.subject: champion
questions.label: Napoleon Dynamite
questions.question: Which of these champions has a dance that references Napoleon Dynamite?
questions.answer: Before his rework, Master Yi danced another part of the same dance.

questions.subject: champion
questions.label: Jump on It
questions.question: Which of these champions has a dance that references Will Smith's "Jump on It" dance from The Fresh Prince of Bel-Air?
questions.answer: Kayle shared the dance with him until hers was changed.

questions.subject: champion
questions.label: Billie Jean
questions.question: Which of these champions has a dance that references Michael Jackson's Billie Jean?

questions.subject: champion
questions.label: Jailhouse Rock
questions.question: Which of these champions has a dance that references Elvis Presley's Jailhouse Rock?
questions.answer: Pantheon shared the dance with him until Pantheon's rework.

questions.subject: champion
questions.label: Moonwalk
questions.question: Which of these champions has a dance that references the Moonwalk?
questions.answer: Only on foot: Kled moonwalks when Skaarl is not with him.

questions.subject: champion
questions.label: Haka
questions.question: Which of these champions has a dance that references the haka, the Māori warrior dance?

answerFor.Rengar: His dance is the Ka Mate haka in particular.

questions.subject: champion
questions.label: Breakdance move
questions.question: Which of these champions has a dance based on a breakdance move?

answerFor.Camille: Her dance is the airflare, which she shares with Kennen.
answerFor.Kennen: His dance is the airflare, which he shares with Camille.
answerFor.Rammus: His dance is the back spin.

questions.subject: champion
questions.label: Girls' Generation
questions.question: Which of these champions has a dance that references a song by Girls' Generation?

answerFor.Ahri: Her dance references Run Devil Run.
answerFor.Syndra: Her dance references the choreography of Hoot.

questions.subject: champion
questions.label: Seinfeld
questions.question: Which of these champions has a dance that references Elaine Benes' dance from Seinfeld?
questions.answer: Her first dance was Will Smith's "Jump on It" from The Fresh Prince of Bel-Air, which she shared with Singed.

questions.subject: champion
questions.label: Johnny Bravo
questions.question: Which of these champions has a dance that references Johnny Bravo?
questions.answer: Before his rework he danced to NSYNC's Bye Bye Bye, a dance he shared with Tryndamere.

questions.subject: champion
questions.label: Adventure Time
questions.question: Which of these champions has a dance that references Jake from Adventure Time?
questions.answer: It is Jake's dance from the episode Power Animal.

questions.subject: champion
questions.label: Can-can
questions.question: Which of these champions has a dance that references the can-can?

answerFor.Elise: Her spiderlings dance along with her.
answerFor.Urgot: He shares the dance with Elise and with Veigar's Final Boss skin.

questions.subject: champion
questions.label: Beauty and the Beast
questions.question: Which of these champions has a dance that references Disney's Beauty and the Beast?
questions.answer: He kept the dance through his rework.

questions.subject: champion
questions.label: Capoeira
questions.question: Which of these champions has a dance that references capoeira?
questions.answer: His dance is the ginga, the basic footwork of capoeira.

questions.subject: champion
questions.label: Belly dance
questions.question: Which of these champions has a dance that references belly dancing?

questions.subject: champion
questions.label: Tai chi
questions.question: Which of these champions has a dance that references tai chi?
questions.answer: His dance is the 24-form, a standard tai chi sequence.

questions.subject: champion
questions.label: Sprinkler
questions.question: Which of these champions has a dance that references the Sprinkler?

questions.subject: champion
questions.label: How to Train Your Dragon
questions.question: Which of these champions has a dragon form whose dance references How to Train Your Dragon?
questions.answer: It is the scene from The Hidden World in which Toothless dances to impress the Light Fury.

questions.subject: champion
questions.label: Dab
questions.question: Which of these champions dabs when using an emote within 10 seconds of a takedown?

questions.subject: champion
questions.label: Forced to dance
questions.question: Which of these champions has an ultimate that makes the enemies it stuns play their dance emote?
questions.answer: Her ultimate, Crescendo, plays an irresistible chord.

questions.subject: champion
questions.label: Rift Scuttler joins in
questions.question: Which of these champions makes a nearby Rift Scuttler join in when he dances?
questions.answer: He plays the tune he hums in 'The River King' with his tongue.

questions.subject: champion
questions.label: Fred Astaire
questions.question: Which of these champions has a dance that references Fred Astaire?

answerFor.Fiora: Her dance references his Puttin' On the Ritz from the film Blue Skies.
answerFor.Swain: His dance references Top Hat, White Tie and Tails, and he whistles a tune from his theme while dancing.

questions.subject: champion
questions.label: Game of Thrones
questions.question: Which of these champions has a dance that references Game of Thrones?

answerFor.Kalista: Her dance references Oberyn Martell's spear dance.
answerFor.Riven: Her dance resembles the Water Dance of Braavos.

questions.subject: champion
questions.label: Cossack dance
questions.question: Which of these champions has a dance that references the Cossack dance?

answerFor.Tryndamere: His dance is the hopak. Before an early patch he danced to NSYNC's Bye Bye Bye instead.

questions.subject: champion
questions.label: Dougie
questions.question: Which of these champions has a dance that references the Dougie?

questions.subject: champion
questions.label: Michigan J. Frog
questions.question: Which of these champions has a dance that references Michigan J. Frog from the cartoon One Froggy Evening?

questions.subject: champion
questions.label: Hare Hare Yukai
questions.question: Which of these champions has a dance that references the ending dance of The Melancholy of Haruhi Suzumiya?
questions.answer: The dance is Hare Hare Yukai, and he kept it through his visual update.

questions.subject: champion
questions.label: Shaolin Soccer
questions.question: Which of these champions has a dance that references the film Shaolin Soccer?

questions.subject: champion
questions.label: Melbourne Shuffle
questions.question: Which of these champions has a dance that references the Melbourne Shuffle?

questions.subject: champion
questions.label: Futurama
questions.question: Which of these champions has a dance that references the Grunka Lunkas from Futurama?

questions.subject: champion
questions.label: Chris Farley
questions.question: Which of these champions has a dance that references Chris Farley's Chippendales audition?
questions.answer: Before his rework, he danced to Moskau by Dschinghis Khan.

questions.subject: champion
questions.label: Oliver & Company
questions.question: Which of these champions has a dance that references Disney's Oliver & Company?

questions.subject: champion
questions.label: PONPONPON
questions.question: Which of these champions has a dance based on the PONPONPON music video?

questions.subject: champion
questions.label: Lezginka
questions.question: Which of these champions has a dance that references the lezginka?

questions.subject: champion
questions.label: Cannot max every ability
questions.question: Which of these champions is the only one who cannot max out all of their abilities?
questions.answer: Each of his four abilities has six ranks, 24 points in all, but levels give only 18 (21 with the top lane quest and an Elixir of Skill).

questions.subject: champion
questions.label: Tobias
questions.question: Which of these champions is the only one who still calls Twisted Fate by his birth name, Tobias?

questions.subject: champion
questions.label: Summons an enemy unit
questions.question: Which of these champions is the only one who can summon an enemy unit?
questions.answer: Her E, Test of Spirit, pulls out an enemy champion's spirit as a unit of its own.

questions.subject: champion
questions.label: Cut them down
questions.question: Which of these champions kept only one quote, "Cut them down.", through her rework?

questions.subject: champion
questions.label: No Void in the title
questions.question: Which of these champions from the Void is the only one without 'Void' in their title?
questions.answer: His title is the Mouth of the Abyss.

questions.subject: champion
questions.label: Two critical strike animations
questions.question: Which of these champions is the only one with two different critical strike animations?
questions.answer: He has one for each arm's attack.

questions.subject: champion
questions.label: Self but not allies
questions.question: Which of these champions has the only single-target ability that can be cast on themselves but not on allies?
questions.answer: Her ultimate, Frozen Tomb, can target an enemy or Lissandra herself, but never an ally.

questions.subject: champion
questions.label: Passive that does nothing
questions.question: Which of these champions is the only one whose passive cannot do anything at level 1?
questions.answer: Her passive, Draw a Bead, gives bonus attack range that grows with her level, and at level 1 it gives none.

questions.subject: champion
questions.label: Highest AD ratio
questions.question: Which of these champions has an ability that, fully stacked, has the highest AD ratio in the game?
questions.answer: A fully stacked Rend scales with up to 8915% AD at max rank.

questions.subject: champion
questions.label: No AP ratio
questions.question: Which of these champions has not a single ability power ratio?
questions.answer: There are only 23 champions without any AP ratios.

questions.subject: champion
questions.label: Dancing with Yasuo
questions.question: Which of these champions dances in sync with Yasuo when the two dance next to each other?

questions.subject: champion
questions.label: Dancing with Xayah
questions.question: Which of these champions starts a unique dance when dancing next to Xayah?

questions.subject: champion
questions.label: Eureka!
questions.question: Which of these champions gains a buff called "Eureka!" after scoring a pentakill?
questions.answer: The buff reads "...FOR SCIENCE!" and lasts 25 seconds.

questions.subject: champion
questions.label: On the Case
questions.question: Which of these champions earns 1 extra gold for every takedown scored together with an allied Vi?
questions.answer: Both get a buff called On the Case, which reads "Piltover's Finest."

questions.subject: champion
questions.label: Pirate Hunter
questions.question: Which of these champions got a buff called "Pirate Hunter" in an easter egg removed in patch 3.14?
questions.answer: Gangplank got one of his own, Pirate: "Yarr! I'm a mighty pirate!" Hers read "Yarr! I'm a mighty pirate… hunter!"

questions.subject: champion
questions.label: Queen of the Freljord
questions.question: Which of these champions could be crowned Queen of the Freljord in a removed easter egg?
questions.answer: When two of the three met on opposing teams, a quest told them to take each other down, and the winner wore an ice crown. The easter egg was turned off with Ashe's voice update in patch 9.20.

questions.subject: text
questions.label: A Poro on the Rift
questions.question: Which region must a whole team's champions come from for a Poro to appear outside their fountain on Summoner's Rift?

questions.subject: champion
questions.label: Zilean's rival
questions.question: Which of these champions gains 1 armor for each enemy Zilean nearby?
questions.answer: Zilean in turn gains 1 ability power for each enemy Volibear nearby, a nod to designer Tom 'Zileas' Cadwell, who had opposed adding the champion. Before the rework the two dealt bonus damage to each other instead.

questions.subject: champion
questions.label: Grandmaster at Angling
questions.question: Which of these champions sometimes catches a fish while standing idle in the river?
questions.answer: The buff is called Grandmaster at Angling. A fish gives 1 ability power and 1 gold, and a rare one 10 of each.

questions.subject: champion
questions.label: Drawn to Tristana
questions.question: Which of these champions gains 1 bonus movement speed when moving toward an allied Tristana?

questions.subject: champion
questions.label: Who's a good girl?
questions.question: Which of these champions can be petted by a hand that looks like the old game cursor, through a chain of emotes?
questions.answer: Pressing Ctrl+1 twice gets a pat on the head, Ctrl+2 after that a scratch on the neck, and Ctrl+3 after that a belly rub.

questions.subject: champion
questions.label: A witch's hat
questions.question: Which of these champions gets a witch's hat instead of a Rabadon's Deathcap when Ornn's forge upgrades it?
questions.answer: The hat keeps the upgraded item's stats, and its text reads: "'Friend.' Yes, it is a funny word. Yet perhaps I understand its purpose."

questions.subject: champion
questions.label: Another name in chat
questions.question: Which of these champions goes by another name in the chat while in another form?

answerFor.Anivia: While reborn as an egg, she is called Eggnivia.
answerFor.Gnar: While transformed, he is called Mega Gnar.

questions.subject: item
questions.label: Tons of damage
questions.question: Which of these items comes up in the shop when you search for "tons of damage"?
questions.answer: It is the catchphrase of Riot's David 'Phreak' Turley in his Champion Spotlights. Before patch 10.23 the shop even showed it as the item's description.

questions.subject: champion
questions.label: Throwing the Blue Sentinel
questions.question: Which of these champions gets 10 mana back by throwing the Blue Sentinel?
questions.answer: Throwing it with Force of Will also takes 1 second off the cooldown, and throwing the Red Brambleback burns the enemies it hits like the red buff.

questions.subject: champion
questions.label: Inverse Ninja Strength
questions.question: Which of these champions lost 1 health for every other ninja on their team, in a removed easter egg?
questions.answer: The buff was called Inverse Ninja Strength: "Ninjas are more effective when they work alone." It was removed in patch 3.14.

questions.subject: champion
questions.label: A soul from the start
questions.question: Which of these champions made an enemy Thresh start the game with one soul, hinting at Senna's release?
questions.answer: The easter egg was removed in patch 9.20, and Senna came out two patches later.

questions.subject: text
questions.label: Bilgewater in force
questions.question: Which of these appears on Summoner's Rift when five or more Bilgewater champions are in the game?
questions.answer: Dark Waters skins count too, and the sharks swim in the lower right corner of the map.

questions.subject: champion
questions.label: Black mist in the fountains
questions.question: Which of these champions was teased before release by a black mist covering both fountains at the start of games?
questions.answer: The mist showed up in patches 9.20 and 9.21.

questions.subject: champion
questions.label: A face on the walls
questions.question: Which of these champions was teased before release by a symbol of the champion's face placed on walls on Summoner's Rift?

questions.subject: champion
questions.label: At home in the river
questions.question: Which of these champions gains 1 bonus movement speed while in the river?

questions.subject: champion
questions.label: Running from Sion
questions.question: Which of these champions gains 1 bonus movement speed when moving away from Sion?
questions.answer: She also gains it when moving toward Talon, who in turn gains it when moving away from her.

questions.subject: champion
questions.label: Zaunite Ingenuity
questions.question: Which of these champions gets a buff called "Zaunite Ingenuity" when on the same team as Ekko?
questions.answer: It reads "Kids from the Undercity stick together." and gives both 1 gold for every takedown they score together.

questions.subject: item
questions.label: haroldandkumar
questions.question: Which of these items comes up in the shop when you search for "haroldandkumar"?
questions.answer: The search term is a nod to the film Harold & Kumar.

questions.subject: champion
questions.label: Two souls
questions.question: Which of these champions drops two souls for Thresh, and two mists for Senna, when taken down?
questions.answer: Sejuani and her boar Bristle drop only one.

questions.subject: champion
questions.label: Plants vs. Zombies
questions.question: Which of these champions got 2 bonus gold for taking down Zyra, in a removed nod to Plants vs. Zombies?
questions.answer: Zyra got the same 2 gold for taking down either of them.

questions.subject: champion
questions.label: Eaten by the shark
questions.question: Which of these champions gets eaten, body and all, when killed by a medium or large Chum the Waters from Fizz?
questions.answer: Heimerdinger, Rumble and Teemo are small too, but are never eaten.

questions.subject: text
questions.label: Cho'Gath Eats the World
questions.question: Which year did Riot release the browser game Cho'Gath Eats the World as an April Fools' joke?
questions.answer: It was taken down the next day. While it was up, Cho'Gath was sold at half price.

questions.subject: text
questions.label: Cho'Gath Eats the World
questions.question: Which arcade game series is the April Fools' game Cho'Gath Eats the World a parody of?
questions.answer: It parodies Rampage World Tour in particular: Cho'Gath climbs and punches buildings to bring them down, city by city.

questions.subject: text
questions.label: Cho'Gath Eats the World
questions.question: Which rock band is the name of the April Fools' game Cho'Gath Eats the World most probably a reference to?
questions.answer: A poster reading "Cho'Gath Eat World" could already be seen in the old splash art of Emumu Amumu.

questions.subject: champion
questions.label: Cho'Gath Eats the World
questions.question: Which of these champions is the final boss of the April Fools' game Cho'Gath Eats the World?
questions.answer: He waits in the last city, Sydney. Hitting him splits him into blobs, and he comes back unless all of them are destroyed.

questions.subject: champion
questions.label: Cho'Gath Eats the World
questions.question: Which of these champions fights Cho'Gath as an enemy in the April Fools' game Cho'Gath Eats the World?
questions.answer: They try to save the cities by killing him, and Battlecast Prime Cho'Gath joins them in Tokyo, firing missiles.

questions.subject: text
questions.label: Cho'Gath Eats the World
questions.question: Which Cho'Gath skin is unlocked by beating the April Fools' game Cho'Gath Eats the World?
questions.answer: Dying while wearing it sends you back to the very first level. Its hat also turns up as a pick-up worth 250 points.

questions.subject: text
questions.label: Cho'Gath Eats the World
questions.question: Which city's level in Cho'Gath Eats the World unlocks the hidden minigame Astro Teemo?
questions.answer: Cho'Gath has to devour the rainbow on top of the Riot building, and Astro Teemo starts right away.

questions.subject: text
questions.label: Astro Teemo
questions.question: Which mobile game is the 2013 April Fools' minigame Astro Teemo a direct copy of?
questions.answer: Teemo flies up while W is held and collects coins, which sometimes spell out words such as GLHF and /DANCE.

questions.subject: text
questions.label: Astro Teemo
questions.question: Which internet meme inspired the rainbow trail behind Teemo in the April Fools' minigame Astro Teemo?
questions.answer: Teemo runs on clouds in his Astronaut skin, and the game comes with a song sung by Teemo himself.

questions.subject: champion
questions.label: Soul Shield
questions.question: Which of these champions once had an ability called Soul Shield, the name of the priciest upgrade in the April Fools' minigame Astro Teemo?
questions.answer: The ability was removed in her rework. In Astro Teemo, the upgrade lets Teemo take an extra hit and costs 30,000 gold.

questions.subject: champion
questions.label: Astro Teemo
questions.question: Which of these champions has an ultimate that is an obstacle in the April Fools' minigame Astro Teemo?

answerFor.Ashe: Her Enchanted Crystal Arrows aim at Teemo, with a blue marker that turns red when they fire.
answerFor.Lux: Steel Legion Lux's Final Spark charges up and fires in a line.

questions.subject: champion
questions.label: The missing cigar
questions.question: Which of these champions had his cigar removed from his splash art for censorship reasons?
questions.answer: The change was at first made in every region, which made "Graves's cigar" a meme for pointless visual changes. Since patch 7.9, regions with lighter censorship rules get the art with the cigar back.

questions.subject: champion
questions.label: Air raid siren
questions.question: Which of these champions had a sound effect changed after a player in Syria pointed out that it sounded like an air raid siren?
questions.answer: It was the sound of him picking up The Package, and Riot changed it promptly.

questions.subject: champion
questions.label: A throne like a cross
questions.question: Which of these champions had a skin's throne made taller over concerns that it resembled a Christian cross?
questions.answer: It was the throne of King of Clubs Mordekaiser, which used to be shorter, with his mace Nightfall resting on its back.

questions.subject: champion
questions.label: Censored love interest
questions.question: Which of these champions has a skin whose splash art is censored in some regions because it shows a love interest of the same gender?

answerFor.Vi: It is her Heartache skin, which shares its theme with Heartthrob Caitlyn.
answerFor.Caitlyn: It is her Heartthrob skin, which shares its theme with Heartache Vi.

questions.subject: champion
questions.label: Skeletons removed
questions.question: Which of these champions had skeletons removed from his base splash art in 2016, so that every region could share the same art?
questions.answer: It was part of the Global Splash Unification of patches 6.7 and 6.8, which gave every region, China included, the same splash art without human skeletons, alcohol, tobacco or excessive gore.

questions.subject: champion
questions.label: Gore removed
questions.question: Which of these champions had gore removed from a skin's splash art in 2016, so that every region could share the same art?
questions.answer: It was part of the Global Splash Unification of patches 6.7 and 6.8, which gave every region, China included, the same splash art without human skeletons, alcohol, tobacco or excessive gore.

questions.subject: champion
questions.label: Matthew Mercer
questions.question: Which of these champions is voiced by Matthew Mercer in English?

answerFor.Gangplank: He has voiced Gangplank since the champion's 2015 update.
answerFor.Kindred: He voices the Wolf, and Marcella Lentz-Pope voices the Lamb.

questions.subject: champion
questions.label: Liam O'Brien
questions.question: Which of these champions is voiced by Liam O'Brien in English?

questions.subject: champion
questions.label: Laura Post
questions.question: Which of these champions is voiced by Laura Post in English?
questions.answer: She also voices her Star Guardian, Spirit Blossom and Risen Legend skins.

questions.subject: champion
questions.label: Roger L. Jackson
questions.question: Which of these champions is voiced by Roger L. Jackson in English?

questions.subject: champion
questions.label: Fred Tatasciore
questions.question: Which of these champions is voiced by Fred Tatasciore in English?
questions.answer: He also voices the Sentinel Graves skin.

questions.subject: champion
questions.label: Karen Strassman
questions.question: Which of these champions is voiced by Karen Strassman in English?
questions.answer: She voices four champions, Cassiopeia, Fiora, Shyvana and Zyra: more than anyone else in the English cast.

questions.subject: champion
questions.label: Erica Lindbeck
questions.question: Which of these champions is voiced by Erica Lindbeck in English?
questions.answer: She voices three champions: Morgana, Taliyah and Zoe.

questions.subject: champion
questions.label: Erik Braa
questions.question: Which of these champions is voiced by Erik Braa in English?
questions.answer: He voices three champions: Draven, Jax and Vel'Koz.

questions.subject: champion
questions.label: Annie's voice
questions.question: Which of these champions has the same English voice actor as Annie?
questions.answer: Cristina Milizia voices both.

questions.subject: champion
questions.label: Kog'Maw's voice
questions.question: Which of these champions has the same English voice actor as Kog'Maw?
questions.answer: Patrick Seitz voices both, and also Lucian's grunts and laughs.

questions.subject: champion
questions.label: Ryze's voice
questions.question: Which of these champions has the same English voice actor as Ryze?
questions.answer: Dave B. Mitchell voices both.

questions.subject: champion
questions.label: Twisted Fate's voice
questions.question: Which of these champions has the same English voice actor as Twisted Fate?
questions.answer: Owen Thomas voices both, and he already voiced Viktor before the champion's 2024 update.

questions.subject: champion
questions.label: Darius's voice
questions.question: Which of these champions has the same English voice actor as Darius?
questions.answer: Chuck Kourouklis voices both.

questions.subject: champion
questions.label: Fizz's voice
questions.question: Which of these champions has the same English voice actor as Fizz?
questions.answer: Both are voiced by Philece Sampler.

questions.subject: champion
questions.label: Graves's voice
questions.question: Which of these champions has the same English voice actor as Graves?
questions.answer: Kyle Hebert voices both.

questions.subject: champion
questions.label: Hecarim's voice
questions.question: Which of these champions has the same English voice actor as Hecarim?
questions.answer: Scott McNeil voices both, and also the Final Boss and Fright Night Veigar skins.

questions.subject: champion
questions.label: Karthus's voice
questions.question: Which of these champions has the same English voice actor as Karthus?
questions.answer: Alessandro Juliani voices both.

questions.subject: champion
questions.label: Kassadin's voice
questions.question: Which of these champions has the same English voice actor as Kassadin?
questions.answer: Adam Harrington voices both, and voiced Karthus, Mordekaiser and Ryze before their updates.

questions.subject: champion
questions.label: Kled's voice
questions.question: Which of these champions has the same English voice actor as Kled?
questions.answer: Spike Spencer voices both.

questions.subject: champion
questions.label: Nami's voice
questions.question: Which of these champions has the same English voice actor as Nami?
questions.answer: Cassandra Lee Morris voices both.

questions.subject: champion
questions.label: Blitzcrank's voice
questions.question: Which of these champions has the same English voice actor as Blitzcrank?
questions.answer: Duncan Watt voices both.

questions.subject: champion
questions.label: Cho'Gath's voice
questions.question: Which of these champions has the same English voice actor as Cho'Gath?
questions.answer: J.S. Gilbert voices both, and voiced Dr. Mundo, Sion and Udyr before their updates.

questions.subject: champion
questions.label: Azir's voice
questions.question: Which of these champions has the same English voice actor as Azir?
questions.answer: Travis Willingham voices both.

questions.subject: champion
questions.label: Camille's voice
questions.question: Which of these champions has the same English voice actor as Camille?
questions.answer: Emily O'Brien voices both.

questions.subject: champion
questions.label: Ashe's voice
questions.question: Which of these champions has the same English voice actor as Ashe?
questions.answer: Melissa Hutchison voices both.

questions.subject: champion
questions.label: Janna's voice
questions.question: Which of these champions has the same English voice actor as Janna?
questions.answer: Erin Fitzgerald voices both.
